name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for an accessible bathroom remodel involves looking for experience in universal design and ADA compliance. Seek a company with a strong portfolio of similar projects, excellent references, and proper licensing and insurance. Ensure they offer clear communication, detailed proposals, and a transparent process for managing permits and inspections. A contractor who understands your specific mobility needs and can integrate accessibility without compromising aesthetics is crucial for a successful outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in universal design and ADA compliance, a strong portfolio, and excellent references. They should be licensed, insured, offer clear communication, and handle permits.
